research.title: Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing 2025
research.subtitle: Built BERTopic/LDA models off of webscrapped papers for their 30th anniversary. Got to go on a fun trip to Hawaii for the conference.

research.title: Placenta Villi Clustering
research.subtitle: Used CV to cluster placenta villi to unify pathologist disagreement. Work eventually published in journal "Placenta".

research.title: AEOP PTSD Research
research.subtitle: I used deep learning to help create a non-biased PTSD detection model for the WRAIR. I really enjoyed my time there!

research.title: Art With Parkinson's
research.subtitle: My senior research project. This is inspired by my time teaching art at my grandma's retirement home. I used deep learning to create a corrective algorithm.

art.title: Creation
art.subtitle: They say the Romans painted their sculptures.

art.title: Time's Grasp
art.subtitle: In Latin, we learned about the Fates, three older women who determined human destinies. I find myself thinking of these Fates anytime when I begin to feel the pressure of time.

art.title: What Making Art Feels Like
art.subtitle: I hope this piece makes you hear the Bwring. Brianngg. Brrraapppttt.

art.title: The Blacksmith
art.subtitle: Are LLMs the first human made tool that we don't fully understand? Like the wild wires coming from the blacksmith's hammer, we created something chaotic and unpredictable. (A more humorous interpretation: what vibecoding feels like)

art.title: Observation One
art.subtitle: The other students at my old art studio.

misc.title: ATconnect
misc.subtitle: I initiated the first ATconnect event in 2025 connecting students and companies across the county to create and share their assistive technology with students with disabilities. I am proud that the club is continuing this event even after I left. They managed to reach over 140 people in 2026!

misc.title: Good Hang with Amy Poehler
misc.subtitle: Recently I've really been enjoying this podcast. I like how Amy Poehler makes it her mission to keep it lighthearted and fun, to lighten up other people's day no matter what.

misc.title: The Big Swing by McKenna Harris
misc.subtitle: A story sequence that I think about a lot. It's powerful to me because it touches on the universal feeling of 'saying goodbye' through a very unique story device.

misc.title: The Paper Menagerie and Other Stories by Ken Liu
misc.subtitle: A book recommended by someone I admire. It introduced me to the science fiction genre and made me realize I love a story that makes me cry.
